journal.title: My console journals
journal.intro: What the devices printed, session by session. You read the whole day of a console you were on with the right to drive it (watching only does not count), or that your team’s bench held that day: every session of that day, other people’s included (all of them for an admin). Kept {days} days.
journal.truncatedHint: The journal reached its size limit for the day: the end is missing.
journal.notice: Consoles are journaled: what the devices print (never what you type without echo, such as passwords) is kept {days} days with who had the keyboard. Whoever was on a console on a given day with the right to drive it, their team and the admins read that console’s whole day back.
